name: Seal Touch
description: Touch the arm of an opponent and seal the qi in it so the hand cannot throw a technique.

name: Nil Grip
description: Close a hand on an opponent and make the arm go slack so it cannot pull free or strike.

name: Voidmark
description: Leave a faint mark of emptiness on an opponent and feel where the mark goes afterward.

name: Voidpalm Strike
description: Strike with a palm emptied of qi so that it passes the guard of an opponent unread.

name: Null Lock
description: Hold a hand on an opponent and keep their qi sealed shut for as long as the hold lasts.

name: Stillness Seal
description: Stamp a seal of stillness on a foe so that the next technique the foe tries fails to form.

name: Vanish Strike
description: Strike from a position that the senses of the opponent have lost for a breath.

name: Slip Away
description: Slip out of a grapple into a gap that was not there a moment before.

name: Shadowless Jab
description: Jab with a finger that casts no warning in the qi and gives the opponent no cue to block.

name: Blink Void
description: Hollow out the space between two spots and cross it in a single quick motion.

name: Empty Sleeve
description: Let a grabbing hand close on an empty sleeve of nothing and slide off.

name: Unmarked Blow
description: Land a blow that leaves no bruise and no mark of qi to show who struck it.

name: Vanishing Blow
description: Drop out of the opponent's senses in mid-swing and land a heavy blow from the blind side.

name: Fading Rush
description: Rush through an opposing line while the body slips in and out of notice.

name: Absence Cloak
description: Wear a thin cloak of nothing that lets a blow pass through where the user is not.

name: Void Parry
description: Parry with an empty forearm that takes the force out of the strike.

name: Emptying Ward
description: Throw a ward that empties the qi from a thrown technique as it meets the ward.

name: Thin Nothing
description: Stretch a film of nothing in front of the face to take a dart's sting.

name: Cloak Sense
description: Feel through the cloak for the pressure of a blow before it falls.

name: Unmaking Ward
description: Cast a ward that unmakes the qi of an incoming technique and leaves it as plain air.

name: Absence Mantle
description: Wrap the user in a thick mantle of nothing that wears every blow away.

name: Dulling Void
description: Open a small hollow around the user in which every qi technique comes out weak.

name: Dead Air
description: Leave a pocket of dead air in front of a caster so that the fire they call fails.

name: Still Pocket
description: Hold a still pocket in the hand and drop a spark or dart into it to be forgotten.

name: Voidfield Sense
description: Read the edge of the hollow and feel what crosses it.

name: Dead Spot
description: Make a dead spot on the ground that spoils the footing and the aim of whoever steps on it.

name: Muffling Veil
description: Draw a veil of nothing over a speaker so that chanted words lose their power.

name: Void Press
description: Widen the hollow so that no technique of lesser force takes shape inside it.

name: Voidwash
description: Wash a curse or a lingering binding into emptiness and leave the ally or the self clean.

name: Deadening Breath
description: Breathe out a breath of nothing that throws the rhythm of the qi in those it reaches.
